name: Guneku Medical Center
description: A medical facility in Guneku with its own Guneku Medical Center letterhead, documented on 25 March 2026. It has a fully equipped laboratory and a surgical theatre.
relationshipToProposedReferenceCentre: Not yet announced. A reference healthcare centre for Guneku was proposed at the GUDECA Europe meeting in Bonn on 28 March 2026; whether it will build on this facility or be a separate institution has not been decided publicly. MEDPHISATG, the medical school hosted at the Palace, is a separate institution.
recruitmentNote: In March 2026 the center sought a Medical Doctor. Whether that post is still open has not been confirmed since.
contactNote: Contact details will be published once the Palace confirms them.
sourceNote: Recorded 2026-09-02 from a document on Guneku Medical Center letterhead dated 25 March 2026. Published only at the status that document supports.
